brief_summary: CHORAL Flow is a randomised, double blinded, placebo-controlled trial of the effects of evolocumab on coronary flow at 12 weeks.
official_title: Cholesterol Reduction With Evolocumab and Coronary MicrovascuLar Function and Coronary Flow: The CHORAL Flow Study

primary_outcomes.measure: Maximal coronary flow velocity changes from baseline to 12 weeks
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Measured at baseline and after 12 weeks of therapy
